Chandra Asri Group is a leading chemical and infrastructure solutions company in Indonesia with a track record of over 31 years in the petrochemical industry. The company employs over 2,000 dedicated staff, incorporates state-of-the art technologies and supporting facilities located strategically in the country’s industrial hub, Cilegon and Serang. As a Growth Partner, Chandra Asri is committed on creating high-value jobs, expanding the domestic petrochemical value chain, and serving the needs of the vibrant and growing Indonesian market. Chandra Asri is currently expanding its portfolio in the energy sector and incorporating its asset as well as operational infrastructure to supports the expansion plan of the second world-scale integrated petrochemical complex in Indonesia, CAP2.
Job Descriptions

• Carry out all routine/non-routine maintenance work related to electrical Equipment, includes regular maintenance patrol, evaluate and take necessary action to fix any electrical problem or follow up problem found in the previous shift.
• Implement the electrical field activity to follow the work instruction and procedure correctly to increase productivity and keep production process smoothly. Check and identify electrical equipment problems to specify root cause to achieve equipment rectification correctly.
• Implement safe working practices and good housekeeping at the activity of Electrical Maintenance team in accordance the safety and health, environment and Quality Management systems.
• Conduct proper waste handling as an impact of those above activities to comply with relevant environmental law and regulation.
• Directly responsible with a shift contractor who assist him to perform his shift job.
• Perform clear written and oral communication among operation, other shift team and contractor during performing his job. Record and report immediately any abnormality to the related section/Department during his duty.

Qualifications

• Min Diploma 3 in Electrical Engineering
• Min 3 years of working experience in the same field
• Able to speak and write in English well
• Familiar with MS Office applications
• Proactive, self-motivated and team work oriented
• Willing to be placed in site office, Anyer - Banten

This position will be placed at site office Cilegon.
Important Notes
Chandra Asri is only releasing official job posting at Chandra Asri Career Site (careers.capcx.com), Linkedin & Jobstreet. The Company will contact shortlisted candidate via official corporate email & phone, and will not send any hardcopy invitation for interview. Please note that the Company doesn’t ask candidates to transfer some amount of money nor cooperate with any travel agent.
BEWARE OF RECRUITMENT SCAM.

wo-jpfa-JR4421.d:
Job Summary**

Responsible for the efficient and effective procurement of non-raw material goods and services for PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk, ensuring optimal value, quality, and timely delivery to support operational needs.

Job Responsibilities**

* Execute end-to-end procurement processes for non-raw materials, including requisition review, vendor selection, negotiation, contract management, and order placement.
* Identify and evaluate potential suppliers, conduct supplier audits, and manage supplier relationships to foster long-term partnerships.
* Negotiate favorable terms, conditions, and pricing with suppliers to achieve cost savings and optimize procurement expenditure.
* Prepare and process purchase orders, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Monitor vendor performance, resolve any issues or discrepancies, and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Maintain accurate procurement records, including vendor master data, contracts, and purchasing documentation.
* Collaborate with internal departments (e.g., finance, operations, engineering) to understand their non-raw material requirements and ensure timely fulfillment.
* Stay updated on market trends, industry best practices, and new technologies in procurement to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of procurement strategies and policies.
* Ensure all procurement activities comply with company ethics, legal requirements, and regulatory standards.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience in procurement, specifically with non-raw materials.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to analyze data and make informed purchasing decisions.
* Proficiency in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
* Understanding of contract law and supply chain principles.
* High level of integrity and ethical conduct.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and good command of English (written and spoken).

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
